response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems experience with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks explicit executive leadership experience, fintech-specific expertise, or a proven track record in scaling engineering teams to the required size (10+ to 30+). His contributions to agentic workflows and event-driven systems are relevant but appear limited to tooling rather than end-to-end architecture ownership.
strengths: Diverse technical background with hands-on experience in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and AI-agent tooling (e.g., MCP code generators).
Proven ability to work across the stack (backend, frontend, embedded) and adapt to multiple languages/frameworks, showing architectural flexibility.
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement, demonstrating passion for technical excellence and knowledge sharing.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current and past roles are primarily individual contributor or senior developer positions.
Limited evidence of fintech-specific expertise (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, or real-time financial decisioning).
Agentic AI experience appears focused on tooling and frameworks rather than production-scale, stateful, multi-agent systems with feedback loops.
